resumen: Reserva: lunes 21 de septiembre a las 9:00, Dra. Isabel Morán, Arenal Centro

eventos.texto: Clínica Arenal, buenos días, good morning.
Let me check.
Hello, I'd like the earliest gynecology checkup. It's for me.
Falta un segundo dato para abrir la ficha
Could I have your full name, and your DNI or date of birth?
La respuesta ya estaba pensada 1,1 s antes
Let me check.
Jordy Pujol Vila born 2nd of February 1969
Okay,
Let me pull up the record.
Ficha encontrada: Jordi P. (por la fecha de nacimiento)
Nada encaja con lo pedido: el seguro no cubre esa especialidad
The patient's plan does not cover that specialty. Do you have any other insurance I could use?
Oh yes, I also have Sanitas.
Let me have a look.
Ofrece el lunes 21 de septiembre a las 9:00 con la Dra. Isabel Morán en Arenal Centro
The earliest I have is Monday the 21st of September at 9 am, Dra. Isabel Morán, Arenal Centro. Shall I book that for you?
Yes, book it.
Right,
Reserva · lunes 21 de septiembre, 9:00 · Dra. Isabel Morán · Arenal Centro
Done, you're booked for Monday the 21st of September at 9 am, Dra. Isabel Morán, Arenal Centro. Is there anything else I can help with?
Let me check.
Thank you. Bye.
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
